Enable changes on this server

Allow this app to change the selected display and save supported pages and collections. Applying this setting reconnects to the server. Board controls are tested with FiestaBoard 10.0.0, 10.1.17 and 10.1.20; other features check their own server support. Changes require confirmation. This is a test draft.
Server administration
System settings and integration administration are not yet available here. Use the server web interface for those settings.

Native draft: manual connection, page library, on-device drafts, supported page name and fixed template edits, explicit template validation and text preview, revision-checked server page saves, display selection, text and page actions, pause, schedule following, fallback page and restore controls. Refresh is manual; there is no background polling. Demo saves, evaluations and board actions are entirely simulated.

Save local draft keeps a recovery copy on this device. A separate confirmed server save updates supported stored page fields when the server advertises the known page protocol and this session opts in. Native discovery, sign-in and initial server setup are available as a testable draft. Collections support revision-checked editing where available. Schedule lists and details are read-only. Flexible text and Canvas editing, OAuth, schedule editing, plugins and administration remain planned. Use the web interface for those features and full visual previews.
